created_at.description: When the transaction was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

purpose.description: Free-text note describing the transaction, or null.

source_type.description: Type of the record that produced this transaction (e.g. Order, Fee, Withdrawal), or null.

source_id.description: ID of the record that produced this transaction, or null.

debited_amount.description: Amount debited in this transaction, as a positive decimal string. Debits increase the account balance (e.g. an incoming merchant_order). "0" when the transaction is a credit.

title.description:

*Max 100 characters*

invoice_time.description:
Custom invoice expiration time in minutes.
Possible values: 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 360, 720, 1440
**Please note** that longer than 20 minutes expiration time only works when the payment and receive currencies are the same. [Read more](https://blog.coingate.com/2017/09/bitcoin-merchant-extend-invoice-expiration-time/)

underpaid_cover_pct.description:
*Min: 0. Max: 10*
This feature allows Merchants to accept orders that are underpaid up to a certain threshold [Read more](https://support.coingate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402503049234-I-underpaid-my-invoice-What-should-I-do-)
